eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED MONTHLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Alabama; at 9:05 AM on AUG 7, 2015 Effective until 10:05 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
This is a coordinated monthly test of the broadcast stations in your area.  We are testing equipment that could quickly warn you during emergencies.  If this had been an actual emergency an official message would have followed the alert tone.  
This concludes this test of the emergency alert system.
